Polyarc mass relative to a reference peak

dot-polyarc_mass.Rd

Evaluates $$m_i = m_t \frac{F_i}{F_t} \frac{C_t}{C_i} \frac{M_i}{M_t}$$ where F is the raw FID area, C the carbon count and M the molar mass.

Usage

.polyarc_mass(area, carbon, mw, ref_area, ref_carbon, ref_mw, ref_mass = 1)

Arguments

area, carbon, mw

FID area, carbon count and molar mass of the peaks.

ref_area, ref_carbon, ref_mw

Same quantities for the reference peak.

ref_mass

Mass (or amount) of the reference peak; 1 gives relative mass.

Value

Numeric vector of masses on the scale of ref_mass. NA where carbon is not positive or ref_area is not positive.
